newsitem.title: ANTIGUA: CRICKET-SRI LANKA TOUR OF CARIBBEAN PUT BACK A WEEK.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA TOUR OF CARIBBEAN PUT BACK A WEEK.

text.p: Sri Lanka's inaugural tour of the Caribbean this year has been put back a week, the West Indies Cricket Board (WICB) announced.
The short tour, including two tests and a one-day international, has been changed to June 1-25 from May 25-June 18.
The schedule was altered "following representation from the Board of Control for Cricket in Sri Lanka", according to the WICB.
World Cup champions Sri Lanka's tour opener against Trinidad and Tobago on June 4 has been switched from Queen's Park Oval, Port of Spain, to Guaracara Park.
The limited overs match against West Indies will be played two days later at Queen's Park Oval.
June 4 Trinidad and Tobago, Guaracara Park
June 6 One-day international, Port of Spain
June 8-10 Leeward Islands, St John's, Antigua June 13-17 First test, St John's, Antigua June 20-24 Second test, Kingstown, St Vincent
